antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in endothelial if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Intense 810nm: high power 2W laser, 370 THz, 10^-15s, single pulse for acute effect targeting cytochrome_c in endothelial. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial alpha_ketoglutarate_dehydrogenase activation.
